title: Mech combat numbers: strong, but on a clock
intent: Make the mech improve survival without guaranteeing victory

evidence.description: measured 140 px/s, 12 rounds in 2 s, drain 9.7 firing vs 2.5 idle over 2 s, stomp 50 and 15 energy

constraints.statement: Energy is the limit - 100 points, 1.25 a second plus 0.6 a round, 15 a stomp - about 80 s standing or 21 s of continuous fire; all of it lives in MECH
Hull 300 with a 400 ms hit window; 140 px/s; cannon 6 rounds/s of 20; stomp 50 within 150 px on a 5 s cooldown, line of sight required
The mech fires from the shared bullet pool through Weapon (GunDef 'mech') and never makes per-shot shake
